BiblicalUsage: Flour is the stuff of daily bread and of royal provision. The tribes bring meal and cakes to the feast when David is made king, and Solomon's table takes thirty measures of fine flour every day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God feeds his people through ordinary flour, and no gift is small when it lands on his table.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
